card.name: Route words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Prepositions and route endings right after an administration verb and its object, such as 'in', 'into', 'to' after 'apply one drop' or the ending of 'intravenously' and 'intramuscularly'. It appears in the Dosage and Administration section.

modes.label: Preposition after apply/instill
modes.description: The small word 'in', 'into' or 'to' that introduces the body site after a verb like apply, instill or massage.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Instill one drop<< into>> the conjunctival sac(s) every

modes.label: Route word endings
modes.description: The closing part of intravenously or intramuscularly, just before rate or site details.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Adults 0.5 mL intraven<<ously>> at a rate not exceeding 1 mL

card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing instruction where the route or body site is being stated, as in 'apply to' or 'given intravenously'.
